title: Negotiation Tracker
description: Negotiation tracker (Interest / Patience / Motivations / Pitfalls) based on the Draw Steel rules. Supports D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e, WFRP 4e, Call of Cthulhu 7e / Pulp Cthulhu, Vampire 5e, OSR (OSE) and Draw Steel. Multiple NPCs, parallel conversations, players roll from chat. Three looks: fantasy scroll, cyberpunk terminal, office document.
